Container.Name: ScoreDeck-Proxy
Container.Overview:
Aggregation proxy for ScoreDeck, a live sports scoreboard on a 7-inch ESP32-S3 panel.
The panel has ~17-40 KB of free heap and cannot parse ESPN directly - the golf scoreboard alone is 1.2 MB. This container normalises 20 leagues into a single ~3 KB payload, diffs scores between polls so a goal survives a device reboot, and resolves broadcast channels per region (ESPN's own data is US-only and ignores a region parameter).
Runs anywhere Docker does. No account, no cloud dependency, no CPU limits - which matters, because the Cloudflare Workers free tier caps CPU at 10 ms per request and the golf and tennis payloads may not fit inside it.
IMPORTANT - network placement: if your panel is on an isolated IoT VLAN it may not be able to reach your Unraid host. Either add a firewall rule, or set Network Type to the panel's VLAN (e.g. br0.20) and give the container its own address on that segment, which needs no rule at all. See docs/DEPLOY.md.
Container.Requires: A ScoreDeck panel on a network that can reach this container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the panel connects to. Not needed if you give the container its own VLAN address.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Shared bearer token. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 24 — then enter the same value on the panel with 'token <value>'. Leaving this empty runs the proxy open to your network.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used to decide what counts as 'today'. A Sunday night NFL game kicks off after midnight in Europe, so this matters.
